params.name: offset
params.description: Skip over this many into the response set; used for paginated results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Provide no more than this many items in the response set.

params.name: preferNotamType
params.description: Preference for NOTAM source type.  Must be one of `domestic`, `international`, or `all`.  When `domestic` (default), domestic are preferred and international is used as fallback.  When `international`, international is preferred and domestic is used as fallback.  When `all`, both domestic and international NOTAMs are returned with any domestic first.  Cannot be used together with `onlyNotamType`.

params.name: onlyNotamType
params.description: Exclusive filter for NOTAM source type.  Must be one of `domestic` or `international`.  When set, only NOTAMs of the specified type are returned with no fallback to the other type.  Cannot be used together with `preferNotamType`.

items.docs: Get all available NOTAMs for a specific Station ID
